reason: The current macro validation HR@10 is 0.4975 versus the 0.5050 baseline, with Electronics declining from 0.42 to 0.36; loss of candidate-relevant historical interests is a hypothesis, not an established cause. Modify model_design to test candidate-conditioned attention and training_evaluation to ensure causal supervision, bounded computation, and faithful deployment. Historical gated-attention successes favor a conservative residual addition with shared embeddings, while the failed candidate-conditioned MLP experiment argues against replacing the existing scoring representation or changing the objective.

plan.model_design: Add one candidate-conditioned attention branch inside SASRec: project each candidate's shared item_emb into a query, project log2feats(seq) into keys, and pool those contextual history features using scaled dot-product attention. For a supervised transition at position t, mask padding and every position after t, including no future targets; return zero pooled vectors for empty prefixes using safe masked normalization. Fuse the pooled vector through a learned projection using normalize(f_t + sigmoid(alpha) * projection(pooled)), initializing alpha to -2 so the existing sequential representation initially dominates; retain the shared item embeddings, existing g residual, scale(), and item_bias without adding separate fitted scorers or the failed experiment's large candidate-concatenation MLP. Implement a shared internal scoring helper used by ranking_loss and predict, with differentiable transition and candidate chunks to bound memory while encoding each history once and keeping every candidate score independent of its chunk companions. Preserve SASRec.__init__, log2feats, ranking_loss(seq, pos, negatives, excluded), predict(seq, candidates), existing attribute names, and public tensor shapes, leaving sampled-softmax cross-entropy, transition selection, and negative masks unchanged.
plan.training_evaluation: Keep SequenceDataset, prefix augmentation, NEGATIVES=256, uniform negative sampling, complete-training-history exclusions, at-most-24 transition selection, AdamW settings, learning-rate schedule, clipping, dimensions, dropout, validation frequency, stopping rules, and category runtime guards unchanged to isolate the attention addition. Preserve train_category(name, device), evaluate(model, arrays, device), write_predict_script(), and predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None); update the writer and saved configuration as needed to reconstruct all new parameters and strictly load exactly one newly trained validation-selected checkpoint per category through the same scoring helper used during training and validation. Add lightweight RNG-preserving checks for finite outputs and gradients on empty and singleton histories, invariance of transition scores to future-item changes, candidate-order and chunk-size equivalence, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity without additional training runs. Retain supplied splits and preprocessing seed 0, seed_all(42) per category, fixed validation users and candidates with evaluation seed 42, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200 and its override, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four dataset routes, trial-local WORKING artifacts, and single-GPU execution within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Report actual per-category and macro validation HR@10 against 0.4975 and 0.5050, treating the pinned host evaluation with 200 users and 99 unique negatives per category as authoritative, without hidden-test access, checkpoint averaging, other-trial reuse, or auxiliary fitted predictors.
